subject: science
passage: Mudskippers are fish of tropical mudflats and mangrove swamps that spend much of the day out of the water, skipping across the mud on their stiff front fins and even climbing the roots of mangrove trees. They manage this because of a set of adaptations unusual in ______ can absorb oxygen through the skin and the lining of the mouth, provided these stay moist, and some species carry a mouthful of water with them to keep their gills wet on land. Their eyes, set high on the head, can be drawn back into fluid-filled sockets to be rewetted.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "They manage this because of a set of adaptations unusual in fish" is a complete independent clause, and "they can absorb oxygen through the skin …" is another independent clause that explains what those adaptations are. A colon can join two independent clauses when the second explains or spells out the first.
explanation.A: Correct. The colon follows a complete independent clause and introduces the clause that explains the adaptations.
explanation.B: Incorrect. With no punctuation, the two independent clauses run together (a run-on sentence).
explanation.C: Incorrect. When "and" joins two independent clauses, a comma is needed before it.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A comma alone cannot join two independent clauses; this creates a comma splice.
